style_rules.type: Two masked name lines. First line uppercase Source Sans 3 600; second line right-aligned italic Source Serif 4 400. Tracking minus .075em. Existing local OFL fonts.
style_rules.layout: Full-scene decorative layer; eight equal vertical columns with #D7E0F4 hairlines. Actual navigation remains above the layer. No body scroll lock.
style_rules.entrance: Name masks translate from 112 percent to zero over850ms, staggered120ms, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). Kicker enters over500ms; supporting note over450ms.
style_rules.handoff: Identity fades and moves upward after1130ms. Shutters scaleY from1 to0 over900ms beginning1050ms with58ms column stagger, cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1). Hero lines settle over1000ms after1250ms,120ms apart.
style_rules.lifecycle: Bounded by2600ms. First eligible session visit only; explicit replay available. Immediate dismissal by Skip, Escape, scrolling, focus, control interaction or page hiding. Bypass for reduced motion, data saving, slow connections and fragment destinations.
style_rules.implementation: Original CSS and native Web Animations API; no copied source, extra animation library, imported artwork, new font or audio. Project-specific style reference only.
